notes: T2 and T3 expect the initial right move to enter a closed bridge and spend energy, contrary to the specification. T2 also compares the x,y position text to scalar player.x.
T5 starts with the same blocked right move, then reaches floor (1,2), not switch (2,2); Space is a no-op, and returning up leaves energy=3 and Playing, not energy=0 and Lost.
T6 likewise reaches (1,2) and presses Space off the switch: energy remains 4 and bridge closed, not energy=3 and bridge open.
